caseNameFull: Nevada and New York v. Stacher
attorneys: Jack Streeter, Special Assistant Attorney General of Nevada, and Paul W. Williams, Special Assistant Attorney General of New York, argued the cause for petitioners. With them on the brief were William T. Matthews, Attorney General, and George M. Dickerson, Special Assistant Attorney General, for the State of Nevada, and Nathaniel L. Goldstein, Attorney General, Wendell P. Brown, Solicitor General, and Edward L. Ryan, Assistant Attorney General, for the State of New York. Lemuel B. Schofield filed an appearance for respondent.

opinions.text:
Cer-tiorari, 345 U. S. 991, to the Seventh Judicial District Court of Nevada, in and for the County of White Pine.

Per Curiam:

Judgment reversed. Biddinger v. Commissioner of Police, 245 U. S. 128; Pierce v. Creecy, 210 U. S. 387.
